final:
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  post out.len() <= keys.len() + 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["x", "mode"], ["1", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "1"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var names: List[str] = []
  var vals: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = copy values[i]
    else if k == "level"
      level = copy values[i]
    else
      var idx = 0 - 1
      for j in range(0, names.len())
        if names[j] == k
          idx = j
      if idx >= 0
        vals[idx] = copy values[i]
      else
        names.append(copy k)
        vals.append(copy values[i])
  var res: List[str] = []
  res.append(mode)
  res.append(level)
  for j in range(0, vals.len())
    res.append(copy vals[j])
  res
